Overture to Despair#000.src: - No weaponry or blessed equipment in common areas.
Overture to Despair#000.dst: - Nada de armas ni equipo bendecido en las zonas comunes.

Overture to Despair#002.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou-

Overture to Despair#005.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#005.dst: Que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio.

similar.text: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.

Overture to Despair#006.src: Different plants require different soils, temperatures and water requirements.
Overture to Despair#006.dst: Cada planta necesita su propio suelo, temperatura y riego.

Overture to Despair#007.src: At first, I was afraid of being labeled as cursed. But power does not come without risk. I am willing to risk everything for power.
Overture to Despair#007.dst: Al principio temía que me tacharan de maldito. Pero el poder no llega sin riesgo. Estoy dispuesto a arriesgarlo todo por el poder.

Overture to Despair#010.src: I only serve customers with something to show me.
Overture to Despair#010.dst: Solo atiendo a clientes que tengan algo que enseñarme.

Overture to Despair#012.src: Do you want to play a song?

Overture to Despair#013.src: - Late checkout will come with a {~}  fine.
Overture to Despair#013.dst: - La salida tardía conlleva una multa de {~} .

Overture to Despair#014.src: You open a page at random...

Overture to Despair#015.src: Unsurprisingly, it's talking about Majin's love life. You look inside.
Overture to Despair#015.dst: Como era de esperar, habla de la vida amorosa de Majin. Miras dentro.

Overture to Despair#017.src: The painting most likely symbolises the destruction of the Auburn of old and the hope of a better time to come.
Overture to Despair#017.dst: El cuadro simboliza, muy probablemente, la destrucción del viejo Auburn y la esperanza de tiempos mejores.

Overture to Despair#018.src: Painted in {~}NA by Piju Rae. This oil masterpiece embraces revolutionary color techniques using pigments sourced from the highland dye production.
Overture to Despair#018.dst: Pintado en {~}NA por Piju Rae. Esta obra maestra al óleo abraza técnicas de color revolucionarias con pigmentos de las tintorerías de las tierras altas.

Overture to Despair#019.src: Yes, hello, you staring at me from across the desk, give me a moment I've ran out of ink.
Overture to Despair#019.dst: Sí, hola, tú, que me miras desde el otro lado del mostrador, dame un momento, que me he quedado sin tinta.

Overture to Despair#020.src: To a lesser extent we also monitor trade between the other districts in Fruma, including anything transported via rail.
Overture to Despair#020.dst: También vigilamos, en menor medida, el comercio entre distritos de Fruma, incluido lo que va por tren.

Overture to Despair#022.dst: La vida se forja para la fuerza

Overture to Despair#023.src: Heather is a simple starting plant to grow in the {p}. Any acidic soil from the {p} can be used in the gardening bed or flower pot.
Overture to Despair#023.dst: Heather es una planta sencilla para empezar en {p}. Cualquier suelo ácido de {p} sirve para el bancal o la maceta.

Overture to Despair#024.src: Excuse me. It has been a long day. Again, any questions?
Overture to Despair#024.dst: Perdona. Ha sido un día largo. Otra vez: ¿alguna pregunta?

Overture to Despair#025.src: To keep it working as intended, the power to issue death sentences should be limited. Giving one trusted official, besides Her Majesty, the right to pass
Overture to Despair#025.dst: Para que funcione como debe, el poder de dictar penas de muerte debería limitarse. Dar a un solo cargo de confianza, aparte de Su Majestad, el derecho a dictar

Overture to Despair#026.dst: Los pétalos caen sobre nuestro destino

Overture to Despair#027.src: Would you like to keep reading?

Overture to Despair#028.src: Right. that is the thirty first time I have had to write that sentence today, the third pot of ink I've been through, and my hands are starting to shake.
Overture to Despair#028.dst: Bien. Es la trigésimo primera vez que escribo esa frase hoy, el tercer tintero que gasto, y me empiezan a temblar las manos.

Overture to Despair#029.src: Do you want to get some ice?

Overture to Despair#030.src: Paper published and written by Majin in {~}IA.
Overture to Despair#030.dst: Artículo escrito y publicado por Majin en {~}IA.

Overture to Despair#033.src: You are gripped by terror. You can't bear to read more.
Overture to Despair#033.dst: El terror te atenaza. No soportas leer más.

Overture to Despair#034.src: "SO YEAH, OF COURSE WE'RE GOING TO REPEAT A FEW QUESTIONS. ALRIGHT? GET OVER YOURSELVES."
Overture to Despair#034.dst: "ASÍ QUE SÍ, CLARO QUE VAMOS A REPETIR ALGUNAS PREGUNTAS. ¿VALE? NO OS LO TENGÁIS TAN CREÍDO."

Overture to Despair#035.src: There's a picture of a funny looking fish. The headline reads as follows:
Overture to Despair#035.dst: Hay una foto de un pez con cara graciosa. El titular dice así:

Overture to Despair#036.src: New Chapter Started: Blossom of Blades
Overture to Despair#036.dst: Nuevo capítulo: La Flor de Cuchillas

Overture to Despair#037.src: "Fish Experts Warn Dangerous New Invasive Fish Headed For {p}. Its Diet? Your-"
Overture to Despair#037.dst: "Expertos avisan: un nuevo pez invasor y peligroso va hacia {p}. ¿Su dieta? Tu-"

Overture to Despair#038.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#038.dst: Reúnete con Sui fuera de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#039.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#039.dst: ...{p}. Ja, los... los turistas no mentían cuando decían que era una obra de arte.
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#040.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#040.dst: Debe de estar bien vivir aquí... poder ignorar todo lo que pasa en los demás sitios...
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#041.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#041.dst: {u}, tenemos que encontrar a ese... ¡a ese Soberano "número uno"! Si lo logramos, entonces... ja, entonces podremos salvar a Rex y a Zeph.
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#042.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#042.dst: ¡¿Por qué no?! ¡Fuiste tú quien quiso irrumpir en Deraj y liberar a todos sin pararse ni a pensarlo!
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#043.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#043.dst: ¡¿Y por qué yo no?! ¡¡Cuanto más esperamos, más opciones hay de que p-pase algo!! ¡Tenemos que irnos ya!
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#044.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#044.dst: Sí, tengo uno. Encontrar al Soberano. Liberar a Rex y a Zeph. ¡Y salir de ahí!
Overture to Despair#044.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#045.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#045.dst: Ya... iré r-rellenando los detalles. ¡Lo haré! ¡Tenemos que irnos ya!
Overture to Despair#045.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#048.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#048.dst: Supongo... ¿el Dosel? ¡Podemos llevarlos al Dosel! Eso... eso sirve...
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#049.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#049.dst: Eh... n-no, supongo que no. Pero- pero podemos buscar a alguien que sí lo sepa y- ¡y sacarle la información!
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#050.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#050.dst: Podemos hacerlo. La capitana Fuhue... ¡me contó algunos de sus métodos! Solo... necesito encontrar a alguien que... lo sepa...
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#051.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#051.dst: ¡¡S-si hace falta!! Pudimos m-matar a Gikyo, ¿no?
Overture to Despair#051.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#052.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#052.dst: Aunque fuera difícil... y Majin es... seguramente más fuerte...
Overture to Despair#052.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#053.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#053.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#056.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#056.dst: Vale, ¡puede que tengas razón! Es que... ¡¡agh!! ¡Hay que hacer algo!
Overture to Despair#056.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#057.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#057.dst: ...cierto. Eso es... listo. La noticia ya habrá corrido desde, eh, {p}, ¿no...? Tendremos que camuflarnos mejor.
Overture to Despair#057.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#058.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
Overture to Despair#058.dst: Y... no sabemos cuánto tardaremos en... encontrar la información. Así que... ¿también un sitio donde quedarnos?
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#059.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#059.dst: Vale. Buscar ropa nueva y un sitio donde quedarnos. Es un plan. Podemos hacerlo.
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#063.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#063.dst: Pues sí. Me crié aquí, en {p}.
Overture to Despair#063.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#064.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#064.dst: Aunque, la verdad... nunca me he ido de aquí. Pienso alistarme en el ejército cuando termine mi vuelta por la provincia.
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#065.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#065.dst: Llevo años ahorrando para un billete de ida y vuelta por toda la provincia... Quiero ver con mis propios ojos las regiones menos afortunadas.
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#066.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#066.dst: Me voy justo después del festival. Emocionante, ¿verdad?
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#067.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#067.dst: Hoteles... hm. Conozco varios, aunque casi todos estarán llenos por el festival que se acerca.
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#068.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#068.dst: Hay un hotel elegante al norte del banco... La Joya de la Corona, creo. Aunque seguramente sea demasiado caro para ustedes.
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#069.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#069.dst: Buena pregunta. La verdad, no estoy seguro... crecer aquí me ha hecho pasar cosas por alto.
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#070.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#070.dst: Sé que los turistas suelen venir a ver nuestras mansiones y castillos. ¿Quizá les interese?
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#073.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#073.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#074.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#074.dst: ¡Todo lo bien que se puede estar! Gracias por preguntar.
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#075.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#075.dst: Me han concedido amablemente una hora libre del trabajo, así que he decidido tomarme el tiempo de... oler las rosas. De admirar la belleza de nuestra ciudad.
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#076.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#076.dst: Ah... turistas de los distritos bajos, ¿me equivoco? Buen uso de su cupo de viaje.
Overture to Despair#076.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#077.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#077.dst: Querrán visitar el bullicioso mercado del oeste, ¡sería una pena perdérselo!
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#078.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#078.dst: Y si desean salir de los límites de la ciudad, ¡he oído que hay guías que los llevan a ver las montañas!
Overture to Despair#078.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#079.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#079.dst: Sí, {p} es famosa por su alta costura, ¿verdad? Seguro que han oído hablar de ello... vengan de donde vengan.
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#080.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#080.dst: La famosa Casa Til ha abierto una tienda de ropa efímera al norte, por si les interesa.
Overture to Despair#080.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#081.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#081.dst: ¡Les deseo lo mejor en su estancia! ¡Alabada sea Su Majestad!
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#083.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#083.dst: Debería haber pensado dónde me iba a alojar... ¡Nunca había cogido un tren, así que toda mi cabeza estaba en que eso saliera bien!
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#084.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#084.dst: ¡Y ahora todos los hoteles menos La Joya de la Corona están llenos! ¿Tendré... tendré que dormir en la calle?
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#085.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#085.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#086.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#086.dst: ¡Oh, gracias, gracias! ¡La mismísima Reina te ha puesto en mi camino!
Overture to Despair#086.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#087.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#087.dst: ...¿tú también andas corto de esmeraldas? ¡Quizá podamos compartir un arbusto cómodo! Ja...
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#088.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#088.dst: ¡Oh, te recordaré para siempre! ¡Has hecho de este festival el mejor de todos!
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#089.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#089.dst: ¡Me muero por contárselo a los míos! Cómo la Reina me bendijo con este milagro...
Overture to Despair#089.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#090.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#090.dst: Pero no fue la Reina quien... ah, da igual.
Overture to Despair#090.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#091.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#091.dst: ¡Hola, hola! ¿Les apetece alguno de nuestros buenos periódicos? Quizá hoy prefieran una revista: he oído cotilleos muy jugosos.
Overture to Despair#091.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#092.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#092.dst: Hm... ¿Me llevo la colección Crown of Seraphim o la Peacock Couture...?
Overture to Despair#092.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#093.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#093.dst: Oh, esto es importante... ¡el sueldo de un año entero se va en esto!
Overture to Despair#093.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#096.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#096.dst: ¡Pues están de suerte! Teniendo en cuenta que esto es una tienda de ropa efímera.
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#097.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#097.dst: Hoy represento a la Casa Til. La nueva línea de primavera está casi agotada, ¡así que compren ahora si les interesa!
Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#098.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#098.dst: Eh... ¿esto es lo que se lleva por aquí?
Overture to Despair#098.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#099.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#099.dst: Oh, sí. Viene gente de toda la provincia a comprar en estos eventos efímeros.
Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#100.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#100.dst: ¡La Casa Til es famosa por llevar los diseños de las plumas de pavo real a sus prendas más extravagantes!
Overture to Despair#100.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#101.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#101.dst: ¡Y las hay en un montón de colores, todos de la producción local de tintes del distrito!
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#102.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#102.dst: No necesitamos nada elegante. Solo... enséñanos lo más barato que tengas, ¿vale?
Overture to Despair#102.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#103.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#103.dst: ¡Madre mía! ¡Debe saber que la moda no es barata, señorita! Permítame recomendarle-
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#104.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#104.dst: No. Solo déjanos comprar lo más barato que tengas.
Overture to Despair#104.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#105.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#105.dst: Ajá... bueno, está bien. Si insiste...
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#106.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106.dst: Aquí tiene, lo más barato que hay. En total serán... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#107.src: Where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#107.dst: Donde las regiones se encuentran por líneas de acero enterrado.

Overture to Despair#108.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#108.dst: Aquí tiene, lo más barato que hay. En total serán... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#109.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#109.dst: Muy bien. Aquí tiene. Y ahora márchense, ¡su actitud no es buena para el negocio!
Overture to Despair#109.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#110.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#110.dst: Vale... ya tenemos la ropa. Ahora solo nos... falta un sitio donde, eh, quedarnos. Un hotel, quizá...
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#111.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#111.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#112.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#112.dst: Ah, han vuelto. Como dije, la ropa cuesta {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#114.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#114.dst: Ah... Miren, aún tengo que vender todas mis existencias, ¡o no cobraré mi extra!
Overture to Despair#114.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#115.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#115.dst: Así que, a menos que quieran comprar más ropa... por favor, márchense.
Overture to Despair#115.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#117.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#117.dst: ¡Vaya, hola y bienvenidos a La Joya de la Corona! ¿En qué puedo ayudarles?
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#119.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#119.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#121.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check out listings...
Overture to Despair#121.dst: Hm, ya veo. En tal caso, permítanme mirar la disponibilidad...
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#122.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#122.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Están de suerte! ¡Parece que nos queda una habitación doble! Pero puede que no dure mucho: ¡se agotan enseguida, se lo aseguro!
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#123.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#123.dst: ¿Una habitación... más grande? ¿Están seguros? Desde aquí solo veo a dos personas, y-
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#124.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#124.dst: Vamos a... tener amigos con nosotras. Es que... eh, aún no han llegado.
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#125.src: I see. I see. That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#125.dst: Ya veo. Ya veo. Eso lo complica bastante...
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#126.src: "Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed."
Overture to Despair#126.dst: "Día tras día, las voces reciben a quienes buscan. Reconoce la verdad y lee los secretos impresos."

Overture to Despair#127.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#127.dst: Ya veo. Ya veo Eso lo complica bastante...
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#128.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#128.dst: ¿Compañía? ¿Y de qué tipo? Si solo quieren socializar, la doble les servirá de sob-
Overture to Despair#128.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#129.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#130.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#130.dst: Mmn. Sí, eso desde luego lo estropea. Hm...
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#131.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#131.dst: Bueno. Supongo que también tenemos libre la suite de lujo. Aunque el precio es bastante elevado...
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#132.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: You're certain? Apologies if I am making assumptions here, but you do not seem the sort who would have-
Overture to Despair#133.dst: ¿Está segura? Perdone si doy algo por hecho, pero no parece de las que tienen-
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#135.src: ...huh. Well, everything seems in order then. Here are your keys, madame.
Overture to Despair#135.dst: ...vaya. Pues parece que todo está en orden. Aquí tienen sus llaves, señora.
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#137.src: {u}, I'm... going up to the room.
Overture to Despair#137.dst: {u}, voy... voy a subir a la habitación.
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#138.src: No. We're... not here for pleasure, {u}. We're here to... to... to save our friends.
Overture to Despair#138.dst: No. No estamos... aquí de placer, {u}. Estamos aquí para... para... para salvar a nuestros amigos.
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#139.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.
Overture to Despair#139.dst: No tengo, eh... hambre. Y, ja, desde luego no estoy de humor para beber.
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#140.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#140.dst: ...aunque tú puedes, eh, echar un vistazo. S-si quieres. Solo... no tardes mucho.
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#141.src: We're in... room {~}, apparently. I'll... leave the door open for you.
Overture to Despair#141.dst: Estamos en la... habitación {~}, parece. Te... dejaré la puerta abierta.
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#142.src: Head to your room and discuss what to do next.
Overture to Despair#142.dst: Sube a tu habitación y habla de qué hacer a continuación.

Overture to Despair#143.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#143.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#144.src: The {p} are known for thier very scenic walks and hikes! I would recommend walking around the lakes or hiking up to the mountains.
Overture to Despair#144.dst: ¡{p} es conocida por sus paseos y rutas tan pintorescos! Le recomendaría pasear por los lagos o subir a las montañas.
Overture to Despair#144.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#145.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#145.dst: {p} también es conocida por su riquísima cultura del alcohol. Elaboramos muchas bebidas distintas que se disfrutan en nuestras tabernas.
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#146.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#146.dst: En este momento no celebramos ningún evento especial por el festival que se acerca.
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#147.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#147.dst: ¡Normalmente organizamos noches de juegos y concursos en el bar!
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#148.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: Oh, ¿algo no está a la altura?
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#149.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#150.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: ¡Le pido disculpas! ¡Mandaremos luego a alguien a ahuecarlas!
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#152.src: Oh I will let our cleaners know to do a better job.
Overture to Despair#152.dst: Oh, avisaré a la limpieza para que lo hagan mejor.
Overture to Despair#152.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#154.src: Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to help with that.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: Por desgracia, no podemos hacer nada al respecto.
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#156.src: Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better!
Overture to Despair#156.dst: ¡Avíseme si puedo hacer algo para mejorar su estancia!
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#158.src: A year of saving... f-finally payed off!
Overture to Despair#158.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#159.src: A... a giant meal, and a nice hotel... and I have it all to m-myself!! Best! Week!! Ever!!
Overture to Despair#159.dst: Un... un banquete enorme, y un buen hotel... ¡¡y todo para m-mí solo!! ¡¡La mejor! ¡Semana!! ¡¡De mi vida!!
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#163.src: ...I had heard that about the Auburn Festival!
Overture to Despair#163.dst: ...¡eso había oído del Festival de Auburn!
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#164.src: I can't say I expected word to reach {p} from over there. Though, let me say... so far, I am very impressed by how {p} handles festivities.
Overture to Despair#164.dst: No esperaba que la noticia llegara desde allí hasta {p}. Aunque debo decir... hasta ahora me impresiona mucho cómo celebra {p} sus fiestas.
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#165.src: Why, the real festivities haven't even begun! You're in for a treat, my friend.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: ¡Si lo bueno ni ha empezado! Le espera todo un espectáculo, amiga mía.
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#166.src: ...by chance, would you let me show you around when the festival starts in full? I've enjoyed our talks so far.
Overture to Despair#166.dst: ...¿me permitiría enseñarle la ciudad cuando el festival empiece de verdad? He disfrutado mucho de nuestras charlas.
Overture to Despair#166.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#167.src: I'd love that. I've never been outside the {p} before... so it would be nice to have someone to guide me, wouldn't it?
Overture to Despair#167.dst: Me encantaría. Nunca había salido de {p}... así que estaría bien tener a alguien que me guíe, ¿no?
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#169.src: Ah, I'm so glad we meet again!
Overture to Despair#169.dst: ¡Ah, me alegro de volver a verte!
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#170.src: Even though you... barged into my room... er, isn't that against hotel policy?
Overture to Despair#170.dst: Aunque te hayas... colado en mi cuarto... eh, ¿no va contra las normas?
Overture to Despair#170.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#171.src: ...oh, well, I won't tell them. You did help me pay for the room, after all! I wish you all the best.
Overture to Despair#171.dst: ...bueno, no diré nada. ¡Al fin y al cabo me ayudaste a pagar la habitación! Te deseo lo mejor.
Overture to Despair#171.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#172.src: Maybe we'll meet again! Perhaps I could buy you a drink at the festival?
Overture to Despair#172.dst: ¡Quizá volvamos a vernos! ¿Y si te invito a una copa en el festival?
Overture to Despair#172.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#173.src: ...oh, you're here. Are you done looking around?
Overture to Despair#173.dst: ...ah, ya estás aquí. ¿Has terminado de mirar por ahí?
Overture to Despair#173.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#174.src: So, um. I've been... planning our next steps. Finding a place to stay was... a good idea, I guess. You were right. I shouldn't... rush into it.
Overture to Despair#174.dst: Bueno, eh. He estado... planeando los siguientes pasos. Buscar un sitio donde quedarnos fue... buena idea, supongo. Tenías razón. No debería... precipitarme.
Overture to Despair#174.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#175.src: But this is a good place to regroup once we... once we get Rex and Zeph back. We should, ha, act as early as possible, though.
Overture to Despair#175.dst: Pero este es un buen sitio para reagruparnos cuando... cuando recuperemos a Rex y a Zeph. Aunque, ja, deberíamos actuar cuanto antes.
Overture to Despair#175.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#176.src: Stop that. You k-keep doing that, acting as if... a-as if the worst is inevitable! It's not helpful!
Overture to Despair#176.dst: Para. Deja de hacer eso. S-siempre igual, como si... c-como si lo peor fuera inevitable. ¡No ayuda!
Overture to Despair#176.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#177.src: Well... don't!! I know already, I know they might be gone, but I- I can't think like that. I can't. I have to believe they're still... fighting!!
Overture to Despair#177.dst: ¡¡Pues... no!! Ya lo sé, sé que puede que ya no estén, pero n-no puedo pensar así. No puedo. ¡¡Tengo que creer que siguen... luchando!!
Overture to Despair#177.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#178.src: ...um. Anyway, we should... l-look around the town. To try and figure out where they're being held. If we can figure that out, then...
Overture to Despair#178.dst: ...eh. En fin, deberíamos... m-mirar por la ciudad. Intentar averiguar dónde los tienen. Si lo averiguamos, entonces...
Overture to Despair#178.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#179.src: Look around the town, I guess... try and figure out where that Sovereign is keeping them. If we can figure that out, then... we can save them.
Overture to Despair#179.dst: Mirar por la ciudad, supongo... intentar averiguar dónde los tiene ese Soberano. Si lo averiguamos, entonces... podremos salvarlos.
Overture to Despair#179.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#180.src: We should start right away. Come on.
Overture to Despair#180.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#181.src: I can't, I can't, I can't. If I stop for... for even a second, I'll... I'll shatter. I have to keep moving. I have to.
Overture to Despair#181.dst: No puedo, no puedo, no puedo. Si me paro... un segundo, me... me haré añicos. Tengo que seguir. Tengo que hacerlo.
Overture to Despair#181.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#182.src: What do you think?! NO, I'm not doing alright!! But I have to do something about it, or... or... I'll shatter.
Overture to Despair#182.dst: ¡¿Tú qué crees?! ¡¡NO, no estoy bien!! Pero tengo que hacer algo, o... o... me haré añicos.
Overture to Despair#182.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#183.src: You can... stay here and rest if you, um, need to. But I'm going to search the city for clues. By myself if... if I have to.
Overture to Despair#183.dst: Puedes... quedarte aquí y descansar si, eh, lo necesitas. Pero yo voy a buscar pistas por la ciudad. Sola si... si hace falta.
Overture to Despair#183.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#185.src: Meet up with Sui outside the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#185.dst: Reúnete con Sui fuera de La Joya de la Corona en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#187.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#187.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#188.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#188.dst: ...¿qué? No, estoy mirando una pared. ¿Qué creías que miraba?
Overture to Despair#188.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#189.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#189.dst: Estos carillones de viento. Son... un símbolo de resistencia en {p}. S... eh, Syndra nos habló de ellos.
Overture to Despair#189.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#190.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#190.dst: El viento representa... la libertad, el libre albedrío. Pero no esperaba que los carillones llegaran hasta aquí...?
Overture to Despair#190.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#191.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#191.dst: ¿Podría... podría significar lo que creo que significa?
Overture to Despair#191.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#192.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#192.dst: ¡Tenía razón! Es un símbolo de resistencia, ¡¡e-eso quiere decir que {p} tiene su propia resistencia!!
Overture to Despair#192.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#193.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#193.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#194.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#194.dst: ...ah. Cierto. Eh, perdona. Es que... me he emocionado.
Overture to Despair#194.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#195.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#195.dst: ...ah. Uy. Espero, eh, no haber hablado muy alto...
Overture to Despair#195.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#196.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#196.dst: E-en fin. Creo que hay... una inscripción en el carillón.
Overture to Despair#196.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#197.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#197.dst: "Los vientos de cambio soplan desde el oeste y estrellan olas de verdad en nuestras costas."
Overture to Despair#197.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#198.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#198.dst: ...¡ahí debe de estar la resistencia! ¡Vamos- vamos a buscarlos!
Overture to Despair#198.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#199.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#199.dst: Encuentra el lugar indicado en el carillón de {p}: Los vientos de cambio soplan desde el oeste y estrellan olas de verdad en nuestras costas.

Overture to Despair#200.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#200.dst: ...ah. Aquí... no parece haber ninguna resistencia. Solo otro carillón.
Overture to Despair#200.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#201.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#201.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#202.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#202.dst: Encuentra el siguiente lugar: Enraizadas en lo alto de la casa de la riqueza y la codicia, las ramas oyen los susurros de la brisa.

Overture to Despair#203.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#203.dst: Encuentra el siguiente lugar: Los susurros hablan de unidad, invocada donde las regiones se juntan por líneas de acero enterrado.

Overture to Despair#204.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#204.dst: Encuentra el siguiente lugar: Día tras día, las voces reciben a quienes buscan. Reconoce la verdad y lee los secretos impresos.

Overture to Despair#205.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#205.dst: ¡Hola, hola! ¿Les apetece alguno de nuestros buenos periódicos? Quizá hoy prefieran una revista: he oído cotilleos muy jugosos.
Overture to Despair#205.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#206.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#206.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#207.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#207.dst: ...eh. Nos interesan mucho sus... eh, sus carillones de viento.
Overture to Despair#207.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#208.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#208.dst: ¿Carillones? ¿Perdone? No tengo ni idea de qué me habla. He oído hablar de ellos allá en {p}, ¿pero aquí? Qué cosa más rara de decir.
Overture to Despair#208.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#209.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#209.dst: Aun así, quizá pueda venderles un periódico. Por curiosidad... ¿de dónde son ustedes dos? ¡Creo que no los había visto por aquí!
Overture to Despair#209.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#210.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#210.dst: Jaja, vaya. Les he preguntado de dónde son, no cómo han llegado. ¡Así que probemos otra vez! ¿De dónde son ustedes dos?
Overture to Despair#210.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#211.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#211.dst: Ah, sí, ¡y yo hoy me he encontrado un lingote de oro en el buzón! Jaja, tendrán que esforzarse más para colármela: ¡en {p} no vive nadie desde hace siglos! ¡Venga, en serio! Lo preguntaba de verdad.
Overture to Despair#211.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#212.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?
Overture to Despair#212.dst: Como todos nosotros: de leche y amor, según dicen. Pero si nos ponemos con el origen del universo, aquí pasamos la noche. Entonces, ¿de dónde son de verdad?
Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#213.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#213.dst: ¡Ahaaa, ya veo! Así que buscan a quienes buscan la verdad. Un empeño noble, desde luego.
Overture to Despair#213.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#214.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#214.dst: Nos, eh, encantaría conocer a más de esos... buscadores... de verdad...?
Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#215.dst: Hay mucha gente afín si uno sabe dónde mirar. ¡Así que permítanme llamar su atención con el Aelumia Times! Es la mejor forma de seguir la actualidad.
Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#216.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#216.dst: En la columna {~} suele imprimirse la frase del día. ¡Léanla y presten mucha atención! Aquí la cosa arranca a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#217.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#217.dst: Les deseo suerte en sus empeños. Que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio.
Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#218.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#218.dst: G-gracias. Eh... ¡que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio!
Overture to Despair#218.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#219.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.
Overture to Despair#219.dst: Sal de la tienda y habla de los siguientes pasos.

Overture to Despair#220.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#220.dst: Que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio. No lo olviden.
Overture to Despair#220.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#221.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#221.dst: ¡Por fin! ¡Por fin, por fin pasa algo bueno!
Overture to Despair#221.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#222.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#222.dst: Ni se me ocurrió que hubiera resistencia en {p}... es que esto parece tan... idílico. Como si... eh, como si aquí no tuvieran... problemas.
Overture to Despair#222.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#223.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#223.dst: Pero... supongo que no sabemos cómo es la vida aquí... eh, en cualquier caso, si son una resistencia, tendrán información.
Overture to Despair#223.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#224.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#224.dst: Toma, dame ese periódico. Vale... Columna {~}... parece que la frase de hoy es... "¿No existen las Squirmle Pot verdes?"
Overture to Despair#224.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#225.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#225.dst: Qué raro. Pero... ¡supongo que nadie va a adivinarlo!
Overture to Despair#225.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#226.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#226.dst: Vale. Vale... ¡e-esto está pasando! Majin Thalas, Soberano "número uno", vamos a por ti...
Overture to Despair#226.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#227.src: I'm... feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#227.dst: Me... me siento mucho mejor ya. Eh... ¿y ahora qué hacemos? Mientras... esperamos a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#227.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#228.src: I long for a worthy opponent, someone I can fully explore the depths of the endless cosmos with. Maybe then my hunger will be satiated.
Overture to Despair#228.dst: Anhelo un rival digno, alguien con quien explorar a fondo las profundidades del cosmos infinito. Quizá entonces se sacie mi hambre.

Overture to Despair#229.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#229.dst: Me siento mucho mejor ya. Eh... ¿y ahora qué hacemos? Mientras... esperamos a medianoche.
Overture to Despair#229.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#230.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#230.dst: Sí... eh, ahora que lo pienso, sí que estoy muerta de hambre...
Overture to Despair#230.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#231.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#231.dst: ¡Me acuerdo de haber visto un restaurante antes! Sígueme.
Overture to Despair#231.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#232.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#232.dst: Creo... que me vendría bien una siesta...
Overture to Despair#232.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#233.src: Okay. I'll meet you in our room.
Overture to Despair#233.dst: Vale. Te veo en la habitación.
Overture to Despair#233.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#234.src: Head to the restaurant and wait at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#234.dst: Ve al restaurante y espera en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#235.src: Oh... this is quite cozy, actually. It... it, ha, doesn't really... compare to the Red Fox... but it works.
Overture to Despair#235.dst: Oh... la verdad es que esto es acogedor. No se puede, ja, comparar con el Zorro Rojo... pero sirve.
Overture to Despair#235.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#236.src: Maybe it's... better that it, isn't the same. I'm not sure I could...
Overture to Despair#236.dst: Quizá... sea mejor que no sea igual. No sé si podría...
Overture to Despair#236.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#237.src: Hello, hello! Welcome to the Peacock Inn! What can I get started for you this evening?
Overture to Despair#237.dst: ¡Hola, hola! ¡Bienvenidas a la Posada del Pavo Real! ¿Qué les pongo para empezar esta noche?
Overture to Despair#237.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#238.src: Today's special dishes are fish tacos, fish miso soup, and yak curry! All locally sourced from our lovely {p}, naturally.
Overture to Despair#238.dst: ¡Los platos especiales de hoy son tacos de pescado, sopa de miso con pescado y curry de yak! Todo de nuestro querido {p}, claro.
Overture to Despair#238.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#239.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#239.dst: Eh... yo tomaré los tacos, por favor.
Overture to Despair#239.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#240.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#240.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#241.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#241.dst: ...se está bien aquí, ¿verdad? Antes no... no me dejaba notarlo. Entiendo por qué se habla tanto de {p}...
Overture to Despair#241.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#242.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even... even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#242.dst: Estoy... agh. Sigo con tanta rabia. ¡Con... todo! ¡¡Con la corona, con los soberanos, con... la gente de {p} también!! Por... por seguir viviendo, aun... aun cuando el mundo parece acabado.
Overture to Despair#242.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#244.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#244.dst: Estoy... agh. Sigo con tanta rabia. ¡Con... todo! ¡¡Con la corona, con los soberanos, con... la gente de {p} también!! Por... por seguir con su vida, aun, aun cuando el mundo parece acabado.
Overture to Despair#244.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#245.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#245.dst: ...pero tenemos algo de esperanza. P-por fin. Rex y Zeph... aún hay una posibilidad de volver a verlos.
Overture to Despair#245.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#246.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?
Overture to Despair#246.dst: Y... ¿es raro que también eche de menos al Dosel? ¿Aunque fueran... pesados, y mandones, y- y un poco... inquietantes?
Overture to Despair#246.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#247.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.
Overture to Despair#247.dst: ...y Yusanu. Espero que esté bien. Ja, ojalá pueda liberar también a su familia. No... eh, no quiero que él pierda a nadie tampoco.
Overture to Despair#247.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#248.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.
Overture to Despair#248.dst: ...espero que no me odie. Después de lo que le dije.
Overture to Despair#248.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#250.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?
Overture to Despair#250.dst: Eh... mientras esperamos. ¿Hay algo de lo que quieras hablar?
Overture to Despair#250.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#251.src: ...it's weird. It feels like the ocean is... raging. Thundering storms and crashing waves, and... and still, it doesn't feel like it's at risk of drowning me?
Overture to Despair#251.dst: ...es raro. Siento el océano como... enfurecido. Tormentas atronando y olas rompiendo, y... y aun así, ¿no parece que vaya a ahogarme?
Overture to Despair#251.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#252.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...
Overture to Despair#252.dst: Como... como si pudiera tomar todo lo que quisiera y no cambiara nada. Y, ja, me asusta un poco. Es tan... distinto a antes, pero...
Overture to Despair#252.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#253.src: ...it feels right. Like this is how it always was supposed to be, and I just... didn't realize.
Overture to Despair#253.dst: ...se siente bien. Como si siempre hubiera tenido que ser así y yo... no me diera cuenta.
Overture to Despair#253.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#254.src: Once it's... over...? I... I hadn't... let myself think about that...
Overture to Despair#254.dst: ¿Cuando... acabe...? No... no me había dejado pensar en eso...
Overture to Despair#254.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#255.src: I, um. I actually... had a dream last night. But, ha, it was- it was just that. Just a dream.
Overture to Despair#255.dst: Eh. La verdad es que... anoche tuve un sueño. Pero, ja, era- era solo eso. Un sueño.
Overture to Despair#255.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: Todos nosotros... Rex, Zeph, los- los chicos de Roughworks... eh, Mora, y- y Syndra... nos reíamos y, y lo pasábamos bien en el Festival de Auburn.
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#258.dst: Comíamos bien... Yuman tocaba música, mientras Rex y Zeph d-discutían... Yusanu y Mora h-hablaban de su último invento, y...
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#260.dst: Cuando... cuando me desperté, ja, estaba l-llorando. ¡Ya, ya lo sé! Es... una tontería. Es una tontería.
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#261.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: ...es, eh, difícil elegir un solo momento. Ha sido como una madre para mí desde que tenía... {~} años.
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#262.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#262.dst: Q-quizá la primera vez que la conocí de verdad. Cuando descubrí mi... mi don, pensé que mi vida se había acabado.
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#263.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#263.dst: ¡E-estaba maldita! Y sabía lo que les p-pasaba a los malditos. Se los llevan y nunca vuelven a verse... o, o los matan sin más. No tenía adónde ir.
Overture to Despair#263.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#264.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: Eh... yo ya había visto a Syndra. Sabía que hablaba con Mora antes de que él... se f-fuera de casa. Así que... ja, pensé... que quizá me ayudaría a mí también.
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#265.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#265.dst: ¡Y- y lo hizo! No se asustó, no me denunció. Solo... me dio un abrazo y me acogió en su casa.
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#266.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#266.dst: Eh, me reunió otra vez con Mora. Tras... c-cinco largos años sola. Ella... me salvó, y ahora... ahora está...
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#267.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#267.dst: ...nunca pude decirle lo mucho que significaba para mí.
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#271.src: And here we are with your orders! You fish tacos, young lady - sturgeon head packed with tangy cabbage, tossed in rice vinegar, crispy seaweed, and punchy umami sauce.
Overture to Despair#271.dst: ¡Y aquí están sus pedidos! Sus tacos de pescado, señorita: cabeza de esturión con col avinagrada en vinagre de arroz, alga crujiente y salsa umami con carácter.
Overture to Despair#271.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#272.src: And another order of fish tacos for you! Please, enjoy!
Overture to Despair#272.dst: ¡Y otra ración de tacos de pescado para usted! ¡Que aproveche!
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#273.src: And for you, the Bubble Heckel Miso Soup! A hearty broth simmered with today's catch and miso paste that ties all the flavours together! Enjoy!
Overture to Despair#273.dst: ¡Y para usted, la sopa de miso de Bubble Heckel! ¡Un caldo contundente con la pesca del día y miso que une todos los sabores! ¡Disfrute!
Overture to Despair#273.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#274.src: And for you, the Yak Potato Curry! A rich, aromatic dish seasoned with wild heather. Tender yak meat and new potatoes! You're in for a treat!
Overture to Despair#274.dst: ¡Y para usted, el curry de yak con patata! Rico y aromático, sazonado con brezo silvestre. ¡Yak tierno y patata nueva! ¡Va a disfrutar!
Overture to Despair#274.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#275.src: Um... so this is a taco...?
Overture to Despair#275.dst: Eh... ¿así que esto es un taco...?
Overture to Despair#275.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#276.src: I, I guess I don't know what I expected, but... um. Not this.
Overture to Despair#276.dst: No sé qué me esperaba, pero... eh. Esto no.
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#278.src: Head back to your hotel room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and get some rest before the meeting later.
Overture to Despair#278.dst: Vuelve a tu habitación del hotel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y descansa antes de la reunión.

Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#300.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Overture to Despair#300.dst: Vuelve a la tienda de periódicos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#302.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#302.dst: Oh, ¿ya es de noche...? Entonces deberíamos volver con el vendedor de periódicos.
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#303.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#303.dst: {u}, antes de entrar. Vamos a... observar, y- y no preguntar demasiado.
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#304.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day was on my way out the door. Oh did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#304.dst: ¡Ah, lo siento muchísimo! Estamos cerrando por hoy, ya iba de salida. Oh, ¿les resultó reveladora la lectura?
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#305.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#305.dst: No existen las Squirmle Pot verdes.
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#306.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#306.dst: ¡Bien, bien! Me alegra que quieran apartar la maleza y oír las historias que importan.
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#307.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#307.dst: La reunión empieza enseguida: tomen las escaleras de detrás y bajen.
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#308.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#308.dst: La reunión empieza enseguida: tomen las escaleras de detrás y bajen.
Overture to Despair#308.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#309.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#309.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#310.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#310.dst: Hoy se nos unen algunos miembros nuevos. Dadles la bienvenida a nuestra sociedad, La Flor de Cuchillas.
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#311.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#311.dst: Bien, Rosa Sangrante. Antes tenías muchas ganas de abrir la sesión. Normalmente estás muy callada... ¿y si hoy hablas tú primero?
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#312.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#312.dst: ...gracias, Jardín del Ocaso. Yo... creo que esto es bastante alarmante, la verdad... Comparando los precios día a día, el pan se ha disparado. {~} más que hace solo una semana, sin previo aviso.
Overture to Despair#312.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#313.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#313.dst: No sé qué podemos... hacer de verdad al respecto, pero ¿no deberíamos... y-ya sabéis... ... ...hacer... ...algo...?
Overture to Despair#313.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#314.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#314.dst: Uf, ¿otra vez? Aún no es una subida imposible, pero los más pobres la van a notar seguro. Gracias por hablar, ahora le toca a otro.
Overture to Despair#314.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#316.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#316.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#318.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#318.dst: ¡Oh, oh! ¡¡La noticia de {p}!! Es- bueno, ¡no sé si es un desastre o algo bueno, la verdad!
Overture to Despair#318.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#319.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#319.dst: Bueno, apenas tuve tiempo de leer el Aelumia Times para la contraseña. ¿Me ponéis al día?
Overture to Despair#319.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#320.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#320.dst: Esto no venía en el Aelumia Times... ¡¡Fuentes anónimas afirman que la Soberana Soosu desafió a Su Majestad, y en público!!
Overture to Despair#320.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#322.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#322.dst: ¿Qué- qué quieres decir? Desafiar, ¿como... salirse del guion en un discurso, o-
Overture to Despair#322.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#323.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#323.dst: ¡Dejó escapar a unos terroristas! ¡Al menos a tres, según mis fuentes! Y también se dice que... ¡¡que la han... ejecutado!!
Overture to Despair#323.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#324.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#324.dst: Yo- ¡chicos! ¡Una Soberana se ha opuesto a la Reina! ¿Qué... qué creéis que significa eso para nosotros? ¿Qué creéis que deberíamos hacer? Si ella pudo hacer algo tan grande-
Overture to Despair#324.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#325.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#325.dst: ¡¿Y que la ejecuten por ello?! ¿Y entonces quién haría lo que hacemos? Además, Soosu siempre fue un poco imprevisible. No es tan sorprendente.
Overture to Despair#325.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#327.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#327.dst: ¡Y en otras noticias! Dicen que vieron al Soberano Majin con un hombre desconocido este sábado. Paseando, pero todos sabemos qué significa eso.
Overture to Despair#327.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#328.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#328.dst: -te escuchamos la próxima vez, Rose- Ah. Eso- he oído que era solo un criado nuevo. Nada importante.
Overture to Despair#328.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#329.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#329.dst: Bueno, de todas formas lo publicaré en el Mensual de Majin. ¡Quizá pueda sacar un escándalo de esto! ...seguramente no, pero nunca se sabe.
Overture to Despair#329.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#330.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#330.dst: Eh... en realidad tenía una pregunta sobre el Soberano Majin.
Overture to Despair#330.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#331.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#331.dst: ¡Oh, por supuesto! Le sigo la pista, así que puedes considerarme experta en todo lo relativo a Majin, eh... señorita... ¿cuál era tu nombre en clave?
Overture to Despair#331.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#332.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#332.dst: Ah, mi... nombre... en clave... eh. Sí. Es- Hierba de Agua. Ese es mi nombre.
Overture to Despair#332.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#333.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#333.dst: ...vale. Eso... eso no encaja del todo con nuestro criterio de nombres, pero- Bah, da igual. ¿Cuál es tu pregunta?
Overture to Despair#333.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#334.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#334.dst: Eh... he oído el rumor de que se llevó a unos presos de {p}.
Overture to Despair#334.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#335.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#335.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Me has destripado la exclusiva jugosa de mañana! Sí, el rumor es cierto.
Overture to Despair#335.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#336.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#336.dst: Al parecer llevó a esos presos a su castillo del este. Y según otro rumor, debajo hay una mazmorra. Tendría sentido: ¿qué dictador no tiene una mazmorra para los disidentes?
Overture to Despair#336.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#337.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#337.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#338.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#338.dst: Que los presos eran exactamente dos y, volviendo a la noticia de Filo de Espinas, ¡que son parte de los Terroristas de {p}! Por eso la guardia alrededor de la Casa Thalas es últimamente muy estricta.
Overture to Despair#338.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#339.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#339.dst: Por cierto, pensaba venderle esta pieza al Aelumia Times. Así que que nadie escriba antes que yo.
Overture to Despair#339.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#340.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#340.dst: Bueno, eh, ¡yo he oído que una de ellos era esa chica fugada de la Casa Athassa! ¿Os acordáis de la prensa rosa de hace unos años? Fue todo un escándalo.
Overture to Despair#340.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#341.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#341.dst: Vaya, ¿la hermana de Cereza Infinita? ¡No sabía que estaba metida en esto! Tsk, qué lástima que la sensatez no sea de familia.
Overture to Despair#341.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#342.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#342.dst: ¡¿Y eso qué más da?! No paráis de hablar de "la que se escapó", y- y hay cosas mucho más importa-
Overture to Despair#342.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#343.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#343.dst: ¡Yo no! Daga Carmesí, por favor, apóyame-
Overture to Despair#343.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#344.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#344.dst: ¡¿Qué vamos a HACER?! Es que- vine aquí porque pensé que juntos podría-
Overture to Despair#344.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#345.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#345.dst: ¡Ah! ¡¡Ah, ah!! ¿Os habéis enterado de que este festival no habrá regalos gratis? Es absolutamente indignante.
Overture to Despair#345.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#348.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#348.dst: ...¡mecachis! ¡Yo y... eh, Arbusto de Sombra... nos hemos dejado el fuego encendido! ¡Nos, eh, vemos en la próxima reunión! ¡Que revelemos los secretos sepultados y traigamos cambio!
Overture to Despair#348.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#349.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#349.dst: Em- es "que desenterremos la verdad sepultada y traigamos el cambio..." La gente nunca lo dice bien-
Overture to Despair#349.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#350.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#350.dst: ¡Va a hacer algo! Y-yo lo sé, sé que va a- tengo que- Chicos, ¿no veis q-
Overture to Despair#350.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#351.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#351.dst: ¡Eso no lo sabes! ¡Y si intentas convencerla, aquí ya no te queremos! Basta de esto, ¿tienes algún plan?
Overture to Despair#351.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#352.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#352.dst: ¡Cada vez que intento pensar uno, me cortáis! Sé que no tengo mucho, pero... pero si trabajamos jun-
Overture to Despair#352.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#353.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#353.dst: ¡Ya está bien, Rosa Sangrante! ¡No podremos revelar los secretos de la monarquía si estamos en prisión! Y ni se te ocurra decir "¿qué secretos?" ¡¡Esto es una noticia enorme!!
Overture to Despair#353.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#354.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#354.dst: Habla con Sui fuera de la tienda de periódicos en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#356.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#356.dst: Quería... quedarme toda la reunión. Pero después de eso, yo... no pude.
Overture to Despair#356.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#357.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#357.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#358.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
Overture to Despair#358.dst: No imaginaba que todos sus nombres fueran tan... raros y siniestros. ¡Tuve que inventarme algo! Alégrate de que no fuera algo peor, ¿vale?
Overture to Despair#358.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#359.src: Look. I had to think on the spot, okay! I just needed a way out.
Overture to Despair#359.dst: Mira. ¡Tuve que improvisar, ¿vale?! Solo necesitaba una excusa para salir.
Overture to Despair#359.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#360.src: ...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
Overture to Despair#360.dst: ...¿de verdad era eso? ¿Ese es el grupo de resistencia de aquí...?
Overture to Despair#360.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#361.src: All they're doing is... is... is sitting around, gossiping about trivial problems! Like... like it's the end of the world!
Overture to Despair#361.dst: Lo único que hacen es... es... ¡sentarse a cotillear sobre problemas triviales! ¡Como... como si fuera el fin del mundo!
Overture to Despair#361.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#362.src: An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
Overture to Despair#362.dst: ¿Sube el pan...? ¿Sin regalos en el festival...? ¡¿A quién le importa?! ¡¡Hay gente... g-gente muriéndose!!
Overture to Despair#362.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#363.src: And... and the one person who was trying to do something kept... k-kept getting shut down... ugh! Why did I think something could f-finally go right...
Overture to Despair#363.dst: Y... y a la única que intentaba hacer algo la... la c-callaban una y otra vez... ¡agh! ¿Por qué pensé que algo p-podría salir bien por fin...?
Overture to Despair#363.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#364.src: Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
Overture to Despair#364.dst: Da igual. Al menos sus cotilleos nos dieron alguna pista útil... ¡s-sabemos seguro dónde están Rex y Zeph!
Overture to Despair#364.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#365.src: So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
Overture to Despair#365.dst: Así que... vamos al castillo y- y recuperemos a nuestros amigos.
Overture to Despair#365.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#366.src: Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
Overture to Despair#366.dst: Brezo Violento mencionó, eh, una mazmorra. Seguramente los tengan ahí... Y-yo puedo sacarlos.
Overture to Despair#366.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#367.src: But... if we just go in, then... there'll probably be too many guards to take out. We need a distraction.
Overture to Despair#367.dst: Pero... si entramos sin más... seguramente haya demasiados guardias. Necesitamos una distracción.
Overture to Despair#367.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#368.src: Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
Overture to Despair#368.dst: ¿Podrías... llamar su atención en la puerta principal? Eh, sé que tienes fuerza de sobra, así que... ¿lo harías?
Overture to Despair#368.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#369.src: A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#369.dst: M-muy bien. Bien. Bien, bien, bien. ¡Vamos, salvemos a nuestros amigos!
Overture to Despair#369.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#370.src: Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
